description: This file defines a class MinWordsUserTurnStartStrategy that implements a user turn start strategy based on a minimum number of spoken words, utilizing transcription frames and interim transcriptions, with methods to process frames and handle speaking states.

classes.name: MinWordsUserTurnStartStrategy
classes.description: Implements a user turn start strategy based on minimum spoken words, considering transcription frames and interim transcriptions.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Initializes the strategy with minimum words and interim usage options.

methods.name: reset
methods.description: Resets internal state to initial values.

methods.name: process_frame
methods.description: Processes incoming frames to detect start of user turn based on word count.

methods.name: _handle_bot_started_speaking
methods.description: Handles frames indicating the bot has started speaking.

methods.name: _handle_bot_stopped_speaking
methods.description: Handles frames indicating the bot has stopped speaking.

methods.name: _handle_transcription
methods.description: Handles transcription frames, updates text, and triggers user turn start if conditions are met.

methods.name: _handle_interim_transcription
methods.description: Handles interim transcription frames and triggers user turn start based on word count.
